svg.aria-label: Anatomy of an Octet frame: a 6-byte header, then a header block of indexed and literal headers
svg.title: Anatomy of an Octet frame: a 6-byte header, then a header block of indexed and literal headers
svg.desc: The REQUEST from the annotated capture. Header bytes 00 00 35 01 01 01 give length 53, type REQUEST, flags END, version 1. The payload is a header block: a count byte of 5, then headers such as 81 00 03 GET for :method.

g.text: Six bytes say how many follow. Nothing is ever searched for.
read in a loop until all 53 arrive, however TCP splits them
INSIDE THAT PAYLOAD: THE HEADER BLOCK
no dynamic table, no Huffman: HPACK's first two tricks only
